description: This line plot illustrates the performance metrics—Precision, Recall, and F1-score—across five different model variants on the HateXplain dataset, as part of an ablation study. The x-axis, labeled “Model Variants,” displays five categories in a categorical, non-linear order: “Full model (Ours)”, “w/o Prompt”, “w/o Augmentation”, “w/o Attention”, and “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”. The y-axis, labeled “Metric (%)”, is scaled linearly from 56.82 to 66.56, with tick marks at regular intervals of approximately 0.5 percentage points. The plot contains three distinct lines: a purple line with circular markers representing Precision, a blue line with circular markers representing Recall, and a brown line with circular markers representing F1-score. The purple Precision line begins at 65.49% for the “Full model (Ours)”, dips to 60.16% for “w/o Prompt”, rises to 63.75% for “w/o Augmentation”, increases further to 64.06% for “w/o Attention”, and ends at 65.44% for “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”. The blue Recall line starts at 65.49% for “Full model (Ours)”, falls to 59.64% for “w/o Prompt”, peaks at 63.75% for “w/o Augmentation”, then declines to 59.17% for “w/o Attention” and finally to 56.82% for “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”. The brown F1-score line begins at 65.49% for “Full model (Ours)”, decreases to 60.16% for “w/o Prompt”, rises to 62.22% for “w/o Augmentation”, drops to 59.67% for “w/o Attention”, and concludes at 57.74% for “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”.
